prompts.title: Forma reciente: victorias, empates y derrotas

Central chart: three categories (VICTORIAS, EMPATES, DERROTAS) as grouped count bars sharing a single zero baseline and one linear count scale auto-scaled to the largest of {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}, with whole-number ticks and unit 'partidos'. Category labels in Spanish centered under each bar pair; a compact key top-right of the chart with a lime square 'Escocia' and a slate square 'Eslovenia'. The lower quarter remains permanently reserved for yellow subtitles.
